comparator.name: German Language and Culture
comparator.sourceNotes: The live 2026-2027 product confirms a 180-EC bachelor organised through German-language proficiency, German linguistics, German literature and cultural studies, a compulsory 25-EC stay at a German-speaking university, third-year specialisation, 30 EC of open elective space and a 10-EC bachelor thesis. Its current Year 1 totals 60 EC. The same product lists the identical 5-EC course Kämpfen, beten, schreiben: Literatur von 750 bis 1700 under both Years 1 and 2. Counting it twice would create an impossible same-course duplication; counting it once leaves the published first two years at 115 EC. The archived 2025-2026 guide shows the outgoing cohort structure: its first year used Deutschland in Bildern and Die Erfindung der deutschen Kultur, while Die Erfindung der deutschen Kultur also completed that cohort's second year. This confirms that the live Year 2 block is cohort-transitional rather than a coherent continuation of the revised Fall 2026 first year. The supported non-duplicated components total 175 EC and are retained; the missing 5-EC component is not invented.

exception.reason: The live 2026-2027 study guide combines a revised 60-EC first year with a second-year block for the preceding cohort: Kämpfen, beten, schreiben is listed in both years under the same course code and cannot be credited twice in one 180-EC pathway. The archived 2025-2026 guide confirms that the earlier cohort reached Year 2 from a different first-year literature sequence. Removing the duplicate leaves 5 EC of the Fall 2026 cohort's future second year unidentified. A complete coherent 180-EC comparator therefore cannot be reconstructed without inventing the replacement or assuming that a student repeats the same course.
exception.curriculumContext: The supported non-duplicated curriculum totals 175 EC. It establishes a 60-EC revised first year in German language, linguistics, literature, culture and digital humanities; 55 EC of identifiable second-year progression including advanced German, language history, cultural memory, philosophy of science and a compulsory 25-EC stay at a German-speaking university; and a 60-EC third-year structure of 20 EC restricted-choice specialisation, a 10-EC German-studies thesis and 30 EC open elective space. The unresolved amount is one 5-EC second-year component for the Fall 2026 cohort.
